notes.title: Stability & Performance Optimizations – July 12
notes.content: [p][b]Crash & Startup Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]DX12 Initialization Error[/b][/p][olist][*][p]If your Windows build is 1909 or newer, please update your OS.[/p][/*][*][p]If you’re on an older Windows version, enable Vulkan compatibility mode.[/p][/*][*][p]While there’s currently no hard requirement for GPU drivers, we strongly recommend keeping your graphics drivers up to date.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][*][p][b]RTX 50-Series Frequent Crashes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Update your driver to version 576.80 or newer.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]RTX 40/30/20-Series Crash Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some models may still experience crashes on the very latest drivers. Please roll back or update to driver version 576.80 for the most stable experience.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Performance Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Up to [b]20–30% higher frame rates[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]20–30% lower CPU usage[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]Resolved issue where coin text sometimes failed to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the need to click once after closing the room announcement before moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected oversized hitbox on the Boss’s horizontal swing.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated vertical “bounce” when monsters walk.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented items from falling off the map at the boundary edges.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled certain debug windows from appearing unexpectedly.[/p][/*][*][p]Restored the missing dash charge when unequipping the “Riftwalker’s Boots.”[/p][/*][*][p]Various other stability and display bug fixes.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you for playing and for your continued support! We’ll keep working to make your adventure smoother and more fun.[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Early Playtest Update - Fix bugs – July 4, 2025
notes.content: [h3]Partial Bug Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed UI blurriness caused by resolution adaptation issues on some devices;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incomplete display issue on narrow-screen monitors;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inability to select UI in fullscreen mode during gameplay (when changing resolution, please use fullscreen or windowed mode); [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game launch failure caused by outdated CPU models (if the game still cannot launch, please contact the admin - Technical);[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where invoking the deity interface using number keys would prevent game progress; [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where after a feedback pop-up appeared in the room, an extra mouse click was needed before movement was possible; [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of Elite Mage monster having excessively loud sound effects, and added them to the adjustable monster volume settings;  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Suggestions for Improving Frame Rate:[/h3][list][*][p]Lower the "Preset" in Settings (recommended first); [/p][/*][*][p]Lower the "Environment" quality in Settings (recommended); [/p][/*][*][p]Try lowering the "Super Resolution Quality" in Settings; changing resolution is not recommended;  [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other bug fixes are still in progress.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]-Darkfallen Survivors DEV[/p]

notes.title: Early Playtest Update – July 2, 2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings,[/b] adventurers! We’ve rolled out a new update packed with tuning, enhancements, and fixes based on recent playtest feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[/p][h3]Gameplay & Level Design Adjustments[/h3][p][b]Circle Collapse Rework:[/b][/p][p]Revamped the first circle collapse challenge for better pacing and clarity. [/p][p][b]Difficulty Tuning:[/b] [/p][p]Early-game difficulty has been lowered, especially on Easy mode, to ensure a smoother onboarding experience.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Balance & Experience Improvements[/h3][p][b]Skill Buffs:[/b][/p][p] Boosted base values of several abilities, with improved critical strike scaling.[/p][p][b]Gear Enhancements:[/b] Weapon and ring affix values have been strengthened across the board.[/p][p][b]Legendary Gear Rework – Breath of the Dying:[/b] [/p][list][*][p] Effect duration extended.[/p][/*][*][p] Now grants damage reduction and instant healing on activation instead of invulnerability.[/p][/*][*][p] Removed critical strike bonus for better balance.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Loot Magnetism:[/b][/p][p]Standardized pickup radius for gold and XP orbs to improve flow and consistency. [/p][p][b]Survivability Upgrades:[/b][/p][p]Multiple new life recovery methods added, and existing healing mechanics enhanced.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][b]Affix Display Issue:[/b][/p][p]Fixed inconsistencies in item affix value displays. [/p][p][b]Crash Stability:[/b][/p][p]Addressed several intermittent crashes. [/p][p]Note: GPU-related crashes on certain devices are still under investigation.[/p]

notes.title: [Patch Notes｜2025/6/18] Bug Fixes & Experience Improvements
notes.content:
Dear players,

The latest patch released on June 18, 2025, brings several important fixes and optimizations aimed at improving overall gameplay stability and user experience. Please find the details below:

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue where the Boss would occasionally stop moving during battles, ensuring smoother combat flow.

Corrected display errors in the stat values of Fates with different rarities to ensure accurate information.

Resolved language recognition errors affecting certain regions for better localization support.

Fixed a bug where equipment tooltips could extend beyond the screen boundaries.

Addressed multiple resolution-related issues, including:
　- Mouse cursor offset
　- Incorrect maximum resolution detection caused by screen scaling

Fixed various issues related to UI text, occasional crashes, and interface interactions to enhance overall stability and user experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We remain committed to improving the game and delivering the best possible experience.
